title: Crossing the Margin Cliff: Toward Relearn-Robust LLM Unlearning via Margin Calibration
abstract: arXiv:2607.27836v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language model unlearning is consistently fragile under relearn attacks. On TOFU, fine-tuning on twenty forget examples substantially recovers held-out forget-set ROUGE for every method we evaluate, and we trace this fragility to optimization geometry. The per-token answer margin of fourteen post-hoc methods spanning gradient, preference, and distillation families converges into a narrow band above the retain reference in 41 of 42 method--size cells, a regularity we call the margin cliff. We prove that this cliff follows whenever the retain coupling holds the diagnostic log-odds of forget content above a floor, a condition that token-saturating losses induce at stationarity and that we verify directly on 34 of 42 cells. Margin Calibration (\textsc{MC}) is a plug-in polish adding a non-saturating margin hinge anchored at the reference's per-token margin plus a KL probe on a disjoint instruction corpus, restoring forget-side pres

translated_title: 跨越边际悬崖：通过边际校准实现再学习鲁棒的大语言模型遗忘
translated_abstract: arXiv:2607.27836v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：大型语言模型的遗忘机制在再学习攻击下始终脆弱。在TOFU数据集上，对二十个遗忘示例进行微调会显著恢复所有评估方法中保留的遗忘集ROUGE分数，我们将这种脆弱性追溯到优化几何结构。跨越梯度、偏好和蒸馏家族的十四种后处理方法中，每个词元的答案边际在41个方法-大小组合中的42个里收敛到保留参考之上的狭窄区间，我们将这种规律称为“边际悬崖”。我们证明，只要保留耦合将遗忘内容的诊断对数几率保持在某一下限之上，这种悬崖就会出现，这是词元饱和损失在稳定状态下诱导的条件，并且我们在34个组合中直接验证了这一点。边际校准（MC）是一种插件式优化，它在参考的逐词元边际上添加非饱和的边际铰链，并在不相关的指令语料库上使用KL探针，从而恢复遗忘侧的表示。
tldr: 该论文发现大语言模型遗忘在再学习攻击下的脆弱性源于“边际悬崖”现象，并提出边际校准（MC）方法，通过非饱和边际铰链和KL探针有效增强遗忘的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies the "margin cliff" phenomenon causing fragility in LLM unlearning under relearn attacks and proposes Margin Calibration (MC), a plug-in method using non-saturating margin hinge and KL probe to restore robustness.
